compiled_state.title: E2E test: --namespace=canon returns only canon-domain rows from federal-style corpus
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
(E2E integration test — DD ownership is implicit via task-A/task-C/task-D/task-F dependencies. Provides end-to-end coverage that dd-2 retrieval semantics work against the dd-1 federal canon corpus produced by task-C.)

## Description
End-to-end behavioral test that exercises the full stack: schema accepts the 6 federal-style canon YAMLs (task-A + task-C), ref-query supports --namespace + --format=json (task-F), _overview.yaml is present and skipped (task-D).

The test issues `bash plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.sh 'error message required field' --namespace canon --format json` and asserts every returned row's tags.domain == 'canon' (or 'canon' in tags.domain) AND at least one row's source_file is one of the 6 federal-style files (uswds-forms.yaml, govuk-errors-forms.yaml, vagov-error-anatomy.yaml, eighteen-f-content.yaml, federal-plain-language.yaml, cdc-reading-level.yaml).

The test does NOT assert BM25 ranking superiority — ranking is non-deterministic at small-corpus scale and not a story DD. Code comment in the test file documents this design decision: 'Ranking superiority is NOT asserted because BM25 ranking is non-deterministic at the corpus level.'

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given the 6 federal-style canon YAMLs from task-C exist and ref-query supports --namespace from task-F; When ref-query 'error message required field' --namespace canon --format json runs against the live corpus; Then every row's tags.domain == 'canon' AND at least one row's source_file matches a federal-style filename pattern AND the test file contains the documented no-ranking-assertion comment.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] E2E test passes
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-ref-query-canon-e2e.sh
- [ ] All rows carry tags.domain == canon
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.sh 'error message required field' --namespace canon --format json | python3 -c "import json,sys; rows=json.load(sys.stdin); assert rows and all((r.get('tags',{}).get('domain')=='canon') or ('canon' in r.get('tags',{}).get('domain',[])) for r in rows)"
- [ ] At least one row from a federal-style source file
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/ref-query.sh 'error message required field' --namespace canon --format json | python3 -c "import json,sys; rows=json.load(sys.stdin); feds={'uswds-forms.yaml','govuk-errors-forms.yaml','vagov-error-anatomy.yaml','eighteen-f-content.yaml','federal-plain-language.yaml','cdc-reading-level.yaml'}; assert any(any(s in r.get('source_file','') for s in feds) for r in rows)"
- [ ] Test file documents no-ranking-assertion design decision
  Verify: grep -F 'Ranking superiority is NOT asserted' plugins/dso/tests/test-ref-query-canon-e2e.sh
- [ ] Test registered in .test-index
  Verify: grep -q 'test-ref-query-canon-e2e.sh' plugins/dso/tests/.test-index
